subject: Invoice delivery & temporary email exception for portal enrollment
messages:
From: Megan Walsh <megan.walsh@greenshore.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Greenshore Finance <ap@ap.greenshore.com>
Date: Thu, 29 Jul 2027 15:23:00 -0400
Subject: Portal enrollment question & invoice sender requirement

Hi Naomi,

Thanks for the walkthrough yesterday. We have one quick compliance ask from our AP team before we move to portal-only delivery: our PO system requires that invoices arrive from the vendor email address on file (vendor@redwoodinference.com).

Two options we discussed internally:
- Enroll in your portal and have the portal push invoices (preferred), or
- Have Redwood continue to send PDF invoices from vendor@redwoodinference.com while we finish the portal rollout (temporary).

For the temporary approach we need:
- Confirmation you can send invoices from vendor@redwoodinference.com for the next 90 days,
- A copy of the signed PO attached to the first emailed invoice, and
- VAT evidence (we’re EU-owned but US-ops; reverse charge might not apply but we need the field on the PDF).

Can you confirm which route you prefer and whether a short exception window is possible?

Best,
Megan
Megan Walsh
Sr. AP Coordinator
Greenshore Inc.
[Attachment: GF-931-signed-po.pdf (PDF)]

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>
To: Megan Walsh <megan.walsh@greenshore.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 30 Jul 2027 09:11:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Portal enrollment question & invoice sender requirement

Hi Megan —

Thanks for the clear ask. We can support a temporary email-based delivery from vendor@redwoodinference.com for up to 90 days while your AP completes the portal enrollment. Two operational notes:

1) We’ll include the signed PO (you attached GF-931) on the first emailed invoice and flag the file with the VAT tag/field you need.
2) Our Billing Ops needs an approval from AP (email confirmation to kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com) acknowledging the exception window and who will own the switch-to-portal date.

I’m CC’ing Kimberly to confirm the exception and to share a sample invoice PDF so you can validate the fields. Ben — I’ve looped you as account owner to track implementation and the cutover plan.

Proposed next steps:
- Kimberly to confirm exception and send invoice sample (PDF).
- Greenshore to reply-all approving 90-day exception and provide preferred remit info.
- Ben and I to schedule a 20-min cutover check-in for the enrollment date.

If that works I’ll mark RDW-4821 with a temporary delivery flag in our billing system.

Thanks,
Naomi Feldman
Senior Revenue Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
[Attachment referenced: invoice_sample_2027-07.pdf (PDF)]

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>, Megan Walsh <megan.walsh@greenshore.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 2 Aug 2027 11:06:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Portal enrollment question & invoice sender requirement

Hi all,

Confirming Billing Ops can issue emailed invoices from vendor@redwoodinference.com for a 90-day exception window starting with the first invoice dated 2027-08-01.

Operational checklist (we will complete before sending):
- Attach signed PO GF-931 to the first invoice email.
- Embed VAT fields on the PDF (VAT number and a reverse-charge note if applicable).
- Add a header line on the invoice PDF: "Temporary email delivery while portal enrollment in progress — invoice may be superseded by portal copy."
- Provide a billing contact for any remittance questions (please confirm below).

Megan — if you can reply with AP approval and remit details (bank ACH or remittance address + VAT handling instruction) we’ll queue the first invoice. I’ve attached the sample invoice layout we’ll use so your AP can verify the fields.

Kimberly Park
Billing Operations Lead
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: invoice_sample_2027-07.pdf (PDF)]

From: Megan Walsh <megan.walsh@greenshore.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Greenshore Finance <ap@ap.greenshore.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 2 Aug 2027 18:42:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Portal enrollment question & invoice sender requirement

Hi Kimberly / Naomi —

Greenshore AP confirms and approves the 90-day temporary exception. Please proceed with email delivery from vendor@redwoodinference.com for invoices dated from 2027-08-01 through 2027-10-29. Remit/details below:

- Remittance: ACH to Bank of Harbor, Account ****1234 (we’ll send full details via secure portal).
- VAT handling: Please include Redwood’s VAT field and a note: "No reverse charge — standard VAT applies"; we’ll reconcile on our side.

We’ve reviewed the sample invoice and the VAT field looks good. Thanks for adding the PO on the first invoice.

One small ask: can you also add an Invoice ID in the email subject (e.g., "Invoice: RDW-4821-0001") so our PO matching can be automated?

Appreciate the quick turnaround — we’ll continue with portal enrollment in parallel and confirm the go-live date as soon as it’s set.

Best,
Megan Walsh
Sr. AP Coordinator
Greenshore Inc.
